newsitem.title: USA: Philip Morris says Miss trial won't have jury.
newsitem.headline: Philip Morris says Miss trial won't have jury.

text.p: Philip Morris Cos Inc said on Friday that the Chancery Court of Jackson County ruled that the Mississippi Medicaid reimbursement lawsuit will not be tried before a jury.
Philip Morris said in a statement that it is "disappointed" by yesterday's court decision.
"The Florida, Texas and Minnesota lawsuits, which are scheduled in 1997, will be tried to juries," the tobacco company said in a statement.
Philip Morris said it believes it is entitled to exercise its constitutional right to present its case to a jury and that it expects to prevail in tobacco liability cases.
Philip Morris representatives were not immediately available for further comment.
